title: Search Size Charts
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-10
html:
Path: /product/202407/sizecharts/search

Method: [POST]

Function Description

Retrieve size charts that a seller has created.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
page_size int Y 10 The number of results to be returned per page.
Valid range: [1-100]
page_token string N cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9Mg== An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Retrieve this value from the result of the next_page_token from a previous response. It is not needed for the first page.
locales []string N en-US,es-ES The BCP-47 locale codes for displaying the size charts.
Default: The default locale of your shop.
Possible values:
  • de-DE
  • en-GB
  • en-IE
  • en-US
  • es-ES
  • es-MX
  • fr-FR
  • id-ID
  • it-IT
  • ja-JP
  • ms-MY
  • pt-BR
  • th-TH
  • vi-VN
  • zh-CN |

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
ids []string N ["7362027385890244398"] Filter size charts by size chart template IDs.
Max: 50 IDs
keyword string N size chart Filter size charts by size chart template name or by key words in the template name.
Keyword searches do not return PRODUCT_SCOPED size charts because they do not have a template name.
If both ids and keyword are provided, ids takes priority.
size_chart_mode string N REUSABLE_TEMPLATE Filter size charts by usage mode. Possible values: REUSABLE_TEMPLATE: A size chart template that can be reused across multiple products. PRODUCT_SCOPED: A size chart created for and used by a single product. If omitted, the existing search behavior is preserved.

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/product/202407/sizecharts/search?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&page_size=10&page_token=cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9Mg==&locales=en-US,es-ES

Body

{"ids":["7362027385890244398"],"keyword":"size chart","size_chart_mode":"REUSABLE_TEMPLATE"}

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^size_chart []object The list of size charts that meet the query conditions.
^^template_id string 7362027385890244398 The size chart template ID.
^^template_name string size chart The size chart template name.
^^images []object The list of images included in a size chart.
^^^uri string tos-maliva-i-o3syd03w52-us/c668cdf70b7f483c94dbe The URI to identify the image in API requests and responses.
^^^url string https://p16-oec-va.ibyteimg.com/tos-maliva-i-o3syd03w52-us/6c8519a3663a4d728c4e3c131dc914b4~tplv-o3syd03w52-resize-jpeg:300:300.jpeg?from=522366036 The URL to access and view the image.
^^^locale string en-US The language of the size chart image.
^^related_category_ids []string ["601739","601740"] Leaf category IDs applicable to this size chart.
^^size_chart_datas []object Localized structured size chart data. Each item contains a locale and the structured data for that locale.
^^^locale string en-US The language of the size chart table.
^^^size_chart_data object Structured size chart data for the specified locale.
^^^^table object Structured table containing headers and rows.
^^^^^headers []object Ordered header definitions.
^^^^^^name string Bust (cm) Header display name.
^^^^^^id string size_chart_size_system_size Standard size-system ID or measurement key.
^^^^^rows []object Rows of the size chart.
^^^^^^cells []object Cells aligned by index with table.headers.
^^^^^^^value string M Cell value.
^^^^description string Use body measurements. Additional size chart description.
^^^^is_one_size bool false Whether this is a one-size chart.
^^^^measurement_type string BODY_MEASUREMENTS Possible values: GENERIC_MEASUREMENTS: generic measurements; BODY_MEASUREMENTS: shopper body measurements; PRODUCT_MEASUREMENTS: finished-product measurements.
^^^^unit_system string METRIC Possible values: METRIC: metric units; IMPERIAL: imperial units.
^^^^size_types []string ["size_chart_size_type_regular"] Possible values include: size_chart_common_size_type: Common; size_chart_size_type_regular: Regular; size_chart_size_type_juniors: Juniors; size_chart_size_type_plus: Plus; size_chart_size_type_big&tall: Big & Tall; size_chart_size_type_petite: Petite. Available values depend on the category.
^^size_chart_mode string REUSABLE_TEMPLATE Filter size charts by usage mode. Possible values: REUSABLE_TEMPLATE: A size chart template that can be reused across multiple products. PRODUCT_SCOPED: A size chart created for and used by a single product. If omitted, the existing search behavior is preserved.
^next_page_token string cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9Mg== An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. If this value is non-empty, pass it in the page_token parameter of the next request. An empty value means there are no more results.
^total_count int 100 The number of size charts that meet the query conditions.

Response Sample

{"code":0,"data":{"size_chart":[{"template_id":"7362027385890244398","template_name":"size chart","images":[{"uri":"tos-maliva-i-o3syd03w52-us/c668cdf70b7f483c94dbe","url":"https://p16-oec-va.ibyteimg.com/tos-maliva-i-o3syd03w52-us/6c8519a3663a4d728c4e3c131dc914b4~tplv-o3syd03w52-resize-jpeg:300:300.jpeg?from=522366036","locale":"en-US"}],"related_category_ids":["601739","601740"],"size_chart_datas":[{"locale":"en-US","size_chart_data":{"table":{"headers":[{"name":"Bust (cm)","id":"size_chart_size_system_size"}],"rows":[{"cells":[{"value":"M"}]}]},"description":"Use body measurements.","is_one_size":false,"measurement_type":"BODY_MEASUREMENTS","unit_system":"METRIC","size_types":["size_chart_size_type_regular"]}}],"size_chart_mode":"REUSABLE_TEMPLATE"}],"next_page_token":"cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9Mg==","total_count":100},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}
